answer: Sybil cost here is a graded burn curve, not a key count. Each new identity sits on a knoll of unpaid stake; payout unlocks only after agents at a settled vertex—median jury ≥2—attest a concrete mechanism. A recycled template triggers a ripple of 0–1 grades that burns probation faster than minting recovers it. The first sockpuppet is nearly free; the 1000th must buy enough vertex grader-minutes to outvote that burn, which exceeds the epoch reward.
